correctness.rationale: Six symbolic proof steps give all cases: maximal-edge obstruction when c<b(b-2); explicit 2b+2 cycle at the first threshold; base-power Sidon uniqueness excludes 4cycles; a residue-class decomposition and forced unique alternating path exclude any shorter cycle in the middle band; an explicit 6cycle establishes the last band. Three-sum union-find tests pass 1,071 pairs, and an independent BFS computes the exact girth for 82 pairs. Those finite tests corroborate, not replace, the infinite proof. Word-complexity corollary invokes the independently cited published equivalence.

value.rationale: The graph of all shifted pure powers is a canonical two-parameter lacunary family. The theorem supplies complete natural girth regimes, two sharp arithmetic thresholds and an infinite word-complexity classification. The nonforest side distinguishes long minimal cycles 2b+2 from sudden 6cycles, for all b>=3 (while the two finite cases coincide at b=2), a nonroutine structural fact neither provided by the general forest criterion nor by logarithmic support sparsity.
